newsitem.title: USA: PG&E sees one cent/shr dilution from buy.
newsitem.headline: PG&E sees one cent/shr dilution from buy.

text.p: PG&E Corp said that its $1.59 billion acquisition of New England Electric System will dilute earnings per share by about one cent in the first two years of ownnership.
"During the first two years the impact would be a penny per share dilutive for 1999 and 2000, beyond that it would be accretive," said Greg Pruett, a spokesman for the company.

Asked whether the company had overpaid for assets with a book value of just $1.1 billion, Pruett said that he did not believe that book value was a true reflection of the value of assets in a non-regulated environment.
"We think that book value was a notion which was very relevant in the days of regulated industry, but is not a true guage of value in a deregulated environment," Pruett said.
